board_name: West Bengal School Board Ecosystem (WBBSE & WBCHSE)

WBBSE.name: West Bengal Board of Secondary Education
WBBSE.headquarters: Nivedita Bhaban, DJ-8, Sector-II, Karunamoyee, Bidhannagar, Kolkata - 700091
WBBSE.jurisdiction: Secondary Education (Class 9 academic support & Class 10 Madhyamik Pariksha)

WBCHSE.name: West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education
WBCHSE.headquarters: Vidyasagar Bhavan, 9/2, Block DJ, Sector-II, Salt Lake, Kolkata - 700091
WBCHSE.jurisdiction: Higher Secondary Education (Class 11 Foundation & Class 12 Uchcha Madhyamik)

class_9.examination_status: Annual School-Level Internal Examination with Official WBBSE Registration
class_9.service_type: Academic Foundation, School-Based Evaluation, Class IX Advance Registration for Madhyamik

progression_to_class_10.rule: Promotion to Class 10 requires passing Class IX annual internal evaluation under WBBSE continuous and comprehensive evaluation (CCE) guidelines and mandatory completion of WBBSE Class IX student online registration.

class_10.service_type: Public Secondary Board Examination, Verified Practice, Model Papers & Revision Compendiums

examination_schedule_and_duration.standard_hours: 10:45 AM to 2:00 PM (3 hours writing + 15 minutes reading time)

second_language_rule.rule_description: If a language other than English is offered as First Language, English is the compulsory Second Language. If English is the First Language, Second Language must be Bengali or Nepali.

class_10.scheme_of_examination: 7 Compulsory Subjects Scheme (First Language, Second Language, History, Geography, Mathematics, Physical Science, Life Science). Each subject carries 100 Marks (90 Written External Board Theory + 10 Internal Formative Evaluation). Total: 700 Marks.

passing_criteria.grading_system: Grade AA (90-100), A+ (80-89), A (60-79), B+ (45-59), B (35-44), C (25-34/Pass Threshold), D (Below 25 / Needs Improvement).

class_11.examination_status: Semester-Based Higher Secondary Foundation (Semester I & II)
class_11.service_type: Council-Monitored Institutional Semester Evaluation, Foundation for Class 12, Stream & Subject Combination Enrollment

progression_to_class_12.rule: Progression to Class 12 requires satisfactory completion and qualifying in Class 11 Semester I & Semester II assessments in accordance with WBCHSE semester progression regulations.

class_12.service_type: Public Higher Secondary Board Examination, Stream-wise Specialization, Blueprint Mock Practice & Full Exam

curriculum_version.historical_pattern: HISTORICAL_ANNUAL_SYSTEM (Pre-2026 Annual Higher Secondary Pattern Preserved)

class_12.language_structure: Two compulsory languages: One First Language (from approved regional languages) + One Second Language (English for non-English FL; Bengali/Nepali/Alternative English for English FL).

set_I_science.description: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biological Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Nutrition, Anthropology, Science of Well Being, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science

set_II_commerce.description: Accountancy, Business Studies, Commercial Law and Preliminaries of Auditing (CLPA), Costing & Taxation, Economics, Commercial Geography, Applied AI, Modern Computer Application

set_III_humanities.description: History, Geography, Political Science, Philosophy, Sociology, Education, Sanskrit Classical, Psychology, Music, Visual Arts

vocational.description: IT & ITES, Automobile, Healthcare, Tourism & Hospitality, Apparel, Beauty & Wellness, Agriculture, Electronics, Plumbing, Banking & Insurance

class_12.scheme_of_examination: Total 5 Compulsory Subjects (2 Languages + 3 Compulsory Electives) + 1 Optional 6th Elective. Each subject carries 100 Marks (70 Theory + 30 Practical for lab subjects, or 80 Theory + 20 Project for non-lab subjects). Total Evaluated Marks: 500 (Best of 5 rule applies).

passing_criteria.rule: Student must obtain minimum 30% marks in Theory and 30% marks in Practical/Project separately in each subject to qualify.
